title: Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.14525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental resul

translated_title: 能量环：稳定特征能量以实现可靠的测试时发现
translated_abstract: 测试时发现旨在在模型已经部署的情况下识别已知类别并检测新颖类别，直接在持续的无标注测试时数据流上运行。现有的TTD方法过于保守，使得已知与未知特征在测试时自适应过程中相互塌缩、难以分离。本文从能量的角度重新审视TTD，发现已知类与未知类之间天然存在的能量间隙是不稳定的且容易塌缩。因此，我们提出能量环，通过将两类类别锚定在各自独立的能量环上来稳定这一间隙。一个轻量级适配器在保留已知类方向的同时扩大基于范数的间隙，而扰动一致性模块则为未知类形成紧凑的聚类。在测试阶段，能量引导的置信度加权提升了预测性能，基于稳定性的校正机制则纠正不可靠的更新。实验结果（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出“能量环”方法，通过将已知类与未知类锚定在不同的能量环上以稳定特征能量间隙，从而在部署后的无标注测试流中实现可靠的已知类识别与新颖类发现。
en_tdlr: Proposes "Energy Ring," which stabilizes the unstable energy gap between known and unknown classes by anchoring them on separate energy rings, enabling reliable recognition of known classes and detection of novel ones during test-time discovery.
